cd /work; python -c "
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
d=pd.read_parquet('/data');d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']);d=d.sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
t=d.temp_forecast;dow=d.date.dt.dayofweek
X=np.column_stack([(dow<5),(dow==5),(dow==6),np.maximum(17-t,0),np.maximum(t-21,0)]).astype(float)
def r(X):
    b=np.linalg.lstsq(X,d.load,rcond=None)[0];e=d.load-X@b;return e
e=r(X);print(e.std())
for k in [1,2,3,7]:print(k,np.corrcoef(e[k:],e[:-k])[0,1])
print(pd.Series(e).groupby(dow).mean())
print(pd.Series(e).groupby(d.date.dt.month).mean())
print(np.corrcoef(e,t)[0,1], np.corrcoef(e.abs(),t)[0,1])
# residual vs temp bins
print(pd.Series(e).groupby(pd.cut(t,[-2,3,8,13,17,21,25,30,36])).agg(['mean','std','count']))
"
cd /work; sed -i 's/17 - t/15 - t/;s/t - 21/t - 20/' model.py; python check.py && python practice.py champion.py model.py
